newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize up on export demand.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize up on export demand.

text.p: Argentine cash maize firmed in brisk trade at Buenos Aires cereals Exchange, with exporters buying heartily to load ships in port, traders said.
Maize rose $2 in Bahia Blanca to $112. Cash soybeans were mainly steady to higher, helped by a firmer Chicago market. Spot cash soybeans rose $1 in Buenos Aires to $296.
Spot sunflower seed benefitted from higher soybeans, and rose $2 in Buenos Aires to $210. Cash wheat followed international prices higher. Spot Bahia Blanca gained $3 to $148.
